text_simplified: The text relates a historical account concerning the behaviour of a child named Ibn Rafiʿ, describing his interactions with his father and his teacher. It illustrates the child’s behavioural pattern within the context of tarbiyah (nurturing) and education in the early Islamic eras.

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'القديمة' means 'old/ancient', not 'early'. 'Early Islamic eras' narrows the timeframe to the beginning of Islamic history, whereas the Arabic could refer to any past Islamic period.
